name: web/Framework debug traceback disclosure
description: [basic] Debug-mode stack trace disclosure on malformed input (CWE-209; Django error-reporting docs): DEBUG=True turns a forced 500 into a full Python traceback with source lines and settings. Keywords: debug traceback disclosure django stack trace verbose error 500. ctrl: prod-mode generic error page lacks trace markers -> not falsified. base_url = endpoint that errors on bad input.

conditions.pattern: Traceback \(most recent call last\)|Django Version|DEBUG = True
